**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

I trial-merged with current main (9bb8d26): no conflicts. Built, ran the touched suites and clippy.

### What looks good
- The fix is one line in `crates/app/src/operation/kinds.rs`: the fallback bottom moves from `WorkOffset(0)` to `BottomOfModel`, with a comment that cites #214. Stored operations keep their numbers, since the fallback only applies when no bottom is stored.
- The old default is pinned as refused (`a_bottom_on_the_g54_plane_is_refused_when_g54_sits_on_the_part_top`), so the refusal is still by name ("must cut downward") and nothing silently cuts zero depth.
- The pinning test is the ribbon's own `quick_params` through `CreateOperation`, with G54 on the part top.
- `fresh_op_tests.rs` carries its provenance line.

### Local results (trial merge with main)
| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-ui --lib` (fresh_op + height_row, targeted) | 9 passed, 0 failed |
| `camcraft-ui --lib` (all) | 250 passed, 0 failed, 2 ignored |
| app `mill2d_b` | 9 passed |
| app `area_open` | 10 passed |
| app `whole_model_pocket` | 5 passed |
| app `shoulder_adaptive` | 3 passed |
| app `roughing2d` | 7 passed |
| app `pick_doors` | 5 passed |
| app `heights` | 11 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | exit 0 |

No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic` is added in source; the `expect` calls are in the `cfg(test)` module.

### Requested before merge
None.

### Questions / notes (not blocking)
1. This reverses a default that was deliberate ("issue 2"). AGENTS.md asks that decisions taken like this get a `RECOMMENDED.md` entry. Could you add one (what was chosen, why, what was dropped)? The PR does not touch `RECOMMENDED.md`, so this is only a ledger request.
2. A zero-thickness model still seeds a zero-depth operation, which is refused by name. The PR says so; it is fine as is.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 3f036648841017dc61e9ca9af1962c58fa19b1a6 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

Re-review of the new head (3f03664, after the merge of main through #178). I trial-merged it with current main: no conflicts, GitHub reports it MERGEABLE.

### What looks good
- The fix is one line in `crates/app/src/operation/kinds.rs:65`. The fallback bottom moves from `WorkOffset(0)` to `BottomOfModel`, with a comment citing #214. Stored operations keep their numbers, because the fallback applies only when no bottom is stored.
- The old default is pinned as still refused by name ("must cut downward") in `a_bottom_on_the_g54_plane_is_refused_when_g54_sits_on_the_part_top`. Nothing can silently cut zero depth.
- The pinning test runs the ribbon's own `quick_params` for kinds 1-4 through `CreateOperation`, with G54 on the part top.
- No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic` is added in source; the ones in `fresh_op_tests.rs` are in the `cfg(test)` module. The new file has a provenance line. The PR body ends `Fixes #214` and has a `Changelog:` line, and `CHANGELOG.md` is untouched.

### Local results (merged with main)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-ui --lib` (from `crates/ui`) | 259 passed, 1 failed, 2 ignored (the failure is `tool_editor_snapshot`, see below) |
| app `mill2d_b` | 9 passed |
| app `area_open` | 10 passed |
| app `whole_model_pocket` | 5 passed |
| app `shoulder_adaptive` | 3 passed |
| app `roughing2d` | 7 passed |
| app `pick_doors` | 6 passed |
| app `heights` | 11 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | exit 0 |

The one failure also fails on plain `origin/main` in my worktree (same panic, so it is not caused by this PR):
```
thread 'egui_app::tests::tool_editor_snapshot' panicked at ...\library\core\src\ptr\mod.rs:847:1:
test result: FAILED. 0 passed; 1 failed
```
This is an environment issue on my Windows machine, not a defect in the PR.

### Requested before merge
None.

### Questions / notes (not blocking)
1. This reverses a deliberate default ("issue 2"). AGENTS.md asks that such decisions are recorded. A short `docs/decisions/214-<slug>.md` (chosen, why, dropped) would do it, and a maintainer can add it at merge.
2. A zero-thickness model still seeds a zero-depth operation. It is refused by name, as the PR says.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
